issue.title: Day strip, redesigned — two calm lines under the daily note's plan badges
issue.description: On every canonical daily note that has a `bob-plan` block, the Day strip renders directly under the plan badges, in Live Preview and Reading view, as two calm, readable lines. The first line holds five facts (`WORKED 5h 25m  REVIEWED 64  DONE 30 CREATED 40  REVIEW CLOSED not yet`). The second holds the area time mix plus `so far · HH:MM`. Nothing overlaps or overflows under real Obsidian styles, a preview harness enforces that, and the CodeMirror end-of-note mount is gone.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/day_strip_under_the_badges.md requests this work

issue.title: New Day strip look — facts line, time-mix line, no buttons, hostile-CSS preview
issue.description: strip-look: in bob-plugins' bob-ledger-tools, redesign the Day strip model, painter, and CSS into the two-line layout of the design contract. Use LABEL-value facts, then a time-mix row with `so far · HH:MM`. Drop the history marks, the collapse chevron, and `Stats ↗`. Use no `<button>` elements. Rebuild the preview matrix so it applies Obsidian's baseline button and link rules, places the strip under mock plan badges, and fails on overflow, overlap, a skeleton height mismatch, or a busted budget. Rewrite the model and painter tests, then sync.

issue.title: Mount the strip under the bob-plan badges and delete the end-of-note mount
issue.description: strip-home: in bob-plugins' bob-ledger-tools, host the Day strip inside the rendered `bob-plan` block of canonical daily notes, after the badges, in Live Preview and Reading view. Replace the mount tests with plan-host tests, update the plugin docs and manifest, then sync.
